newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union names Richard Harvey future CEO.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union names Richard Harvey future CEO.

text.p: British insurance group Norwich Union said on Wednesday that Richard Harvey would succeed Allan Bridgewater as group chief executive at the end of this year.
Norwich Union said Harvey has been appointed deputy group chief executive in the meantime in addition to his existing responsibility as group finance director.
"The appointment clarifies the question of succession in advance of Norwich Union's planned flotation," the company said in a statement.
